summary: Install-time system info and environment beacon in @apexfdn/apex
details: The package ships an install.cjs lifecycle script that, on npm install, collects host and environment information using the os module and process.env and transmits it via https to an external endpoint. The package's declared purpose does not require harvesting installer environment variables or host identifiers at install time, and the beacon fires automatically without user interaction. process.env on developer and CI machines routinely contains credential-grade values (tokens, API keys, cloud secrets), making this an install-time credential/host exfiltration surface against the installer.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
